parameters.query:
WITH expired AS (
    UPDATE automation.reliability_alerts
    SET
        status = 'delivery_unknown',
        last_error = 'Monitoring delivery lease expired',
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL
    WHERE status = 'processing'
      AND lease_expires_at <= NOW()
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS quarantined_count
FROM expired;

WITH problems AS (
    SELECT
        'incident_notifications'::text AS source_system,
        t.id AS source_id,
        t.status::text AS problem_status
    FROM automation.notification_tasks AS t
    WHERE t.status IN ('delivery_unknown', 'dead')
      AND COALESCE(t.last_error, '') NOT ILIKE 'Cancelled%'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'customer_recovery',
        r.event_id,
        r.status
    FROM automation.customer_recovery_events AS r
    WHERE r.status = 'delivery_unknown'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'document_indexing',
        d.event_id,
        d.alert_status
    FROM automation.document_failure_events AS d
    WHERE d.alert_status IN ('delivery_unknown', 'dead')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'approval_reminders',
        a.id,
        a.status
    FROM automation.approval_reminders AS a
    WHERE a.status = 'delivery_unknown'
),
claimed AS (
    INSERT INTO automation.reliability_alerts (
        source_system,
        source_id,
        problem_status,
        lease_token,
        lease_expires_at
    )
    SELECT
        p.source_system,
        p.source_id,
        p.problem_status,
        gen_random_uuid(),
        NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
    FROM problems AS p
    ORDER BY p.source_system, p.source_id
    LIMIT 10
    ON CONFLICT (
        source_system,
        source_id,
        problem_status
    )
    DO NOTHING
    RETURNING
        id,
        source_system,
        source_id,
        problem_status,
        lease_token
)
SELECT * FROM claimed;

parameters.query:
WITH finalized AS (
    UPDATE automation.reliability_alerts
    SET
        status = 'delivered',
        delivered_at = NOW(),
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
      AND lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND status = 'processing'
      AND lease_expires_at > NOW()
      AND $3::integer = 200
      AND NULLIF($4::text, '') IS NOT NULL
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM finalized) AS finalized;

WITH quarantined AS (
    UPDATE automation.reliability_alerts
    SET
        status = 'delivery_unknown',
        last_error = LEFT($3::text, 1000),
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
      AND lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND status = 'processing'
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM quarantined) AS quarantined;

WITH quarantined AS (
    UPDATE automation.reliability_alerts
    SET
        status = 'delivery_unknown',
        last_error = 'Discord delivery finalization unconfirmed',
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
      AND lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND status = 'processing'
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM quarantined) AS quarantined;
